user.title: Link to Yuki Family
user.description: In the Yuki Family app: Domotique Maison → « Obtenir mon code ». Paste the 8-character code here (valid for 10 minutes).

reauth_confirm.title: Link to Yuki Family again
reauth_confirm.description: Yuki Family no longer knows this home (it was disconnected in the app). Ask for a new code in Domotique Maison and paste it here.

error.invalid_code: Unknown or expired code: ask for a new one in the app.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach Yuki Family: check the home's Internet connection.

abort.single_instance_allowed: This Home Assistant is already linked to Yuki Family.
